title: The phone writes a location cell the server cannot parse (colon, 4 decimals), so every cell is silently discarded
comment: DEFECTS row D-094. Re-breaks cellFor() in app/public/js/geocell.js back to the pre-fix format "43.2537:-79.9208" that app/src/stores.ts parseCell reads as null.
ifMissed: A contract test that feeds every client-built field (cell, gtin, thresholds) through the server's own parser and asserts none comes back null.
